settings.heading: Freedom for everyday calling. Patriot for rugged family use.
settings.body: There are only two phone choices. Pick the handset that matches your home, then add service and optional add-ons.

settings.label: Monthly
settings.title: Personal phone number + monthly service
settings.body: Simple monthly phone service for the family phone.

settings.label: Annual
settings.title: Personal phone number + annual service
settings.body: Annual service saves $13.12 compared with monthly billing.

settings.title: Call Recording
settings.body: Record and store all calls for 90 days.

settings.title: Time Conditions
settings.body: Set on/off times for incoming calls.

settings.title: Voicemail to Email
settings.body: Unanswered calls go to voicemail and messages are sent to email.

settings.title: Victory Bundle
settings.body: Call Recording, Time Conditions, and Voicemail to Email together.

settings.title: Auto Attendant
settings.body: Help screen spam calls before they interrupt the family phone.

settings.explanation: The product is built around calling and a personal phone number.
Both products are cordless Wi-Fi handsets with charging bases.
The product is positioned as a phone without web browsing.
The product promise is calling without apps, feeds, or the open internet.
Do not market these as included unless the product/service scope changes.
Auto Attendant is available for $5/mo and is presented as an add-on.

settings.question: What is the monthly fee?
settings.answer: Personal phone number plus monthly phone service is $17.76/mo. Annual service is $200/yr and saves $13.12 compared with monthly billing.

settings.question: What is the difference between Freedom Phone and Patriot Phone?
settings.answer: Freedom Phone is the everyday heavy-duty Wi-Fi handset. Patriot Phone is the rugged model with waterproof and dust-proof construction, drop protection up to 1.8 meters, and longer battery life.
